rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something whose truth, outcome, or clarity is not certain.

example.english: I'm still doubtful whether they will come back tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我而家都唔肯定佢聽日會唔會返嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 dou1 m4 hang2 ding6 keoi5 ting1 jat6 wui5 m4 wui5 faan1 lai4

rows.note: Use this when the thing itself seems suspicious or raises doubts about its character.

example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 ho2 ji4 wo3

rows.note: Use this specifically when an event or result is unlikely to happen.

example.english: With the typhoon, it is doubtful that the flight will take off on time.
example.traditional: 今次打風，班機唔大可能準時起飛。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 daa2 fung1 baan1 gei1 m4 daai6 ho2 nang4 zeon2 si4 hei2 fei1

rows.note: Use this for information, evidence, or a person that cannot be relied on.

example.english: This online information is doubtful, so don't take it seriously.
example.traditional: 呢份網上資料唔可靠，唔好當真。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 mong5 soeng6 zi1 liu2 m4 ho2 kaau3 m4 hou2 dong3 zan1
